cuda_fallback_reason: Installed torch is the CPU wheel (2.14.1+cpu); torch.cuda.is_available()==false. Per brief, CPU is the sanctioned fallback; no second CUDA stack was attempted, no AWS used.
augmentation_implementation_note: The permitted aug family (hflip/vflip/90-rot) is the dihedral group D4 = 8 views. Because the encoder is frozen, each view's embedding is fixed, so the 8 D4-view frozen-encoder embeddings were precomputed once per image and the head trained on a random D4 view per image per epoch. Mathematically identical to augmenting pixels through the frozen encoder each step; eval uses the identity view. Not a contract deviation of substance.
early_stopping: none (a-priori-frozen hyperparameters; no leaky inner val; outer test never used for tuning)
loss: cross_entropy, inverse-frequency train-only class weights normalized to mean 1 over classes present in the fold's training rows
evaluation: Leave-One-Group-Out (4 folds: Case-3, Case-4, Case-48, P9); pooled out-of-fold aggregate + per-fold table; absent-class metrics marked UNAVAILABLE
calibration_status: uncalibrated (no temperature scaling; G3 defines no leakage-safe calibration at 4 groups)
oom_retry_fallback_events: none (CPU run; no OOM, no batch-size reduction needed)
